body:
### Summary

If I have `UV_FROZEN` set in the environment (i.e. for CI purposes), and then use `--no-project` (i.e. split CI jobs, don't need the full venv setup for minor scripts), I get the warning:

```shell
$ uv run --no-project test.py
warning: `--frozen` has no effect when used alongside `--no-project`
```

Which isn't the most helpful thing in the world. Should environment variables be ignored for these sort of warnings?

I'd imagine it'd cover the other environment variables as well - `UV_LOCKED`, `UV_NO_SYNC`, etc etc

### Platform

Linux 6.8.0-142-generic x86_64 GNU/Linux

### Version

uv 0.13.3 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

N/A
title: Unhelpful warning when using `--no-project` with `UV_FROZEN` set
